per_artifact_guard_incomplete.evidence: R2.7 guard existed, but R2.9 still left the third artifact in artifact_creation_started without terminal event/result.

render_or_processing_long_without_heartb.evidence: music_inventory.csv was the first heavy semantic CSV artifact and had no bounded stage checkpoints beyond generic artifact_creation_started in the public observation.

lock_contention_or_endpoint_starvation.evidence: summary/events/result/truth/artifacts/queue_health timed out together. TaskRunStore._read and _write shared one global RLock while _write prepared heavy sanitized/spilled payloads.

payload_entity_graph_hydration_large.evidence: music inventory render consumes observed_entity_graph, perception payloads, row validation, metadata coverage, and artifact registry writes.

csv_render_buffer_large.evidence: CSV rows/cells/bytes budgets already exist, but new checkpoints now cover stages before and after CSV write/validation/sufficiency.

metadata_probe_blocking.evidence: R2.9 did not expose a metadata probe checkpoint/result before endpoint starvation.

artifact_registry_index_write_contention.evidence: R2.8 moved artifact writes to sharded manifests and light index; R2.10 preserves that path.

event_emission_overload.evidence: R2.10 checkpoint events are bounded by stage and interval and do not inline rows/entities.

guard_depends_on_worker_or_shared_lock.evidence: Guard/store supervision reads events and result through TaskRunStore; those reads could block behind a long _write critical section.

backend_process_starvation.evidence: Endpoint timeouts across unrelated runtime projections are consistent with worker monopolization or lock contention.

root_cause_model.primary: TaskRunStore read/write lock contention plus insufficient per-artifact observability for long semantic artifacts.
root_cause_model.secondary: Accepted-running guard used a long artifact silence budget and generic reason code; it did not encode artifact semantic kind in artifact_creation_started.

patch_plan.change: Add artifact_attempt_id, content_type, contract_id, artifact_kind, artifact budget and checkpoint interval to artifact_creation_started metadata.
Add bounded artifact_render_checkpoint events at semantic stages: intent resolution, entity selection, perception compile, row rendering, row validation and inventory sufficiency.
Select media inventory stall reason from artifact_kind/contract_id rather than logical path.
Prepare sanitize/spill/json payloads outside the write lock; use the lock only for atomic replacement.
Allow reads without the write lock because writes use unique temp files and atomic replace.
Spill produced_artifacts when heavy so run.json remains lightweight.
Align external artifact terminality reconciliation with accepted-running stall budget default and preserve media inventory stall reason.
